name: openbahia-transit
description: OpenBahía Transit — transporte público abierto de Bahía Blanca

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openbahia/transit-core build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/shared build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/provider-mock build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/provider-gpsbus build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/provider-gpsbahia build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/api build && pnpm --filter @openbahia/web build
